Specification: This module defines a concrete instantiation of part of a distributed transaction model by introducing specific key and client constants and several derived constant mappings. It classifies three clients into optimistic and pessimistic categories, assigns each client its read and write key sets, and identifies a primary key for each client. The file does not define variables, actions, temporal behavior, fairness, or proofs; it is a static configuration-style module layered on top of an extended module.
